notes.title: Update 06/27/2024
notes.content:
Greetings,

Upon booting up Rise of Nations, players will notice a small update. This patch moves Rise of Nations to PlayFab services, which ensures compliance with modern security and platform standards and provides additional stability to the game you know and love. There are no other changes in this patch. Players shouldn't notice any changes to their play experience.

~Rise of Nations team~

notes.title: Troubleshooting: Firewall settings
notes.content:
Greetings,

We recently received a report that a user who was previously unable to load into the game with their firewall active was able to do so once they changed their firewall settings. Below you will see what the user did to allow them to load the game.

When playing Rise of Nations: Extended Edition make sure you have the following enabled for [b]ANY[/b] of your firewall settings. Windows or 3rd party.

[list]
[*]Under your firewall settings add exceptions for both [b] Public [/b] and [b] Private [/b] for any Rise of Nations files that you see
[*] If you've already done this, double check to ensure that your Firewall pop-up hasn't loaded behind the game window. If this has happened it could be asking for permission to run Rise files. Not selecting to allow could cause performance issues
[/list]

This should allow you to load into the game and reduce any issues you may have previously had loading the game. Please let us know if you have any success after making these changes.

Thank you
~Rise of Nations Team~

notes.title: Patch: 1.20 information 08/22/2017
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

 As you know we’ve been heads down working towards resolving the issues that surfaced shortly after the launch of Patch 1.20. After some hard work and help from the community, we feel that we’re now in a place to push patch 1.20 live. Our current target date is later today 08/22/17.

[u][I]Note: This date is subject to change[/i][/u]

Here’s what this update means to you. It means that version 1.10 will no longer default as the primary version of the game. That will be replaced with version 1.20. However, at the request of the community version 1.10 will remain playable after the release of patch 1.20, though you will be required to manually select it from the drop down menu on Steam in order to play.

When we flip the switch later today to patch 1.20 Xbox live players will still be able to join Steam players in match making for Rise games. View the full post on cross-network play below.

http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791435613109/announcements/detail/2514552206143428205

Additionally, below is a list of the latest fixes that will release with patch 1.20.

• Fixed an issue where music volume in settings was not carrying over into gameplay
• Fixed an issue where music cuts out when major events occur in gameplay
• Fixed an issue where music volume was being increased on track rollover
• Fixed an issue where entering combat was not changing music
• Fixed an issue where music was not reverting to economic after combat
• Re-encoded audio files for compatibility
• Fixed an issue that prevented connecting to Online Services if the user had set their Steam Friends status to Offline
• Fixed an issue that prevented videos from displaying in Full screen
• Fixed an issue that caused incompatibility with future versions of Windows 10
• Fixed an issue where multiple players joining a lobby at the same time could cause players to appear as open slots
• Fixed an issue where rapidly joining and leaving a lobby could cause a player to appear as an open slot
• Changed the default video resolution to 1024x768 Full screen


We want to thank the entire community for all of your help and support during our beta branch phase. Your help and involvement truly showed the passion and commitment to this game that we all love. We hope that you will continue show this same love and excitement of the game to the new Xbox live players that will be joining you in version 1.20.

Thank you again
~Rise Of Nations team~

notes.title: ***Beta branch update***: 08/18/2017 - Cross-network play testing
notes.content:
Greetings,

Earlier today it was announced that Rise of Nations: Extended Edition will release as a cross-network play game that will allow players to play against each other on Xbox live, and Steam starting September 14th 2017.

Starting today we are adding Beta users with our Windows 10 UWP version of the game, we hope that you will join in, and help test this exciting new feature.  Nothing should feel different other than you may see some Xbox live players popping in here and there. 

We would love to hear all your feedback and insight on this great new feature, and are excited for the upcoming live release of cross-network play on September 14th. Thank you for all of your help and continued support.

~Rise of Nations Team~

notes.title: Beta branch update: 07/19/2017
notes.content:
Greetings,

There is a new update on the beta branch that should address a few key issues identifed in patch 1.20. Extra participation in this version of the beta branch would be greatly appreciated as the more data we can gather the better. Please leave all feedback in the beta branch section of the forums.

[b] Note: This is not the live branch. This is the beta branch [/b]

•	Fixed some instances of players appearing as an open slot on lobby join
•	Fixed some instances of players appearing with the name "Human" on lobby join
•	Fixed an issue when retrying timed out P2P connections

Thank you again

[b]How to access the Beta branch:[/b]

Your mainline branch will be 1.10. The beta branch will be V1_20_beta. To switch between branches, right-click on the game name from your Steam library and select Properties. Select the Betas tab. Use the drop down box to either opt out of all betas, or choose the V1_20_beta branch.
